name: Crusader Outpost
summary: Scarlet Crusaders watch the eastern road from the heights of Crusader Outpost. Their tower guards the approaches to the Scarlet Monastery and waits for Forsaken incursions.

sections.title: Eyes Over Tirisfal
sections.body: Crusader Outpost watches the eastern road from bluffs above the valley. Scarlet sentries scan the route between Brill and Lordaeron’s eastern reaches, hoping to spot undead and scouting parties before they reach the Monastery gates. The tower also gives the garrison a way to flank forces marching up the valley toward their holy bastion.

sections.title: A Thorn in the Dark Lady's Side
sections.body: Captain Vachon and other Scarlet officers keep the garrison on alert. They regard the woods as unhallowed ground stolen from humanity by monsters, not Forsaken territory. Travelers loyal to the Undercity face an ambush point near the bluffs, where crossbow bolts and cleansing steel await anyone who comes too close.

faq.answer: The Scarlet Crusade holds this watchtower in eastern Tirisfal Glades. Its sentries monitor the road below and guard the southern approach to the Scarlet Monastery.
Captain Vachon commands the Scarlet Crusade zealots who man the outpost. They see all undead as abominations to eradicate on sight.

faq.q: Why is the tower situated in these hills?
faq.answer: The tower’s height gives Crusaders a clear view of Tirisfal Glades’ eastern road. From there, they can spot Forsaken troop movements early and flank forces attacking the Scarlet Monastery.

faq.q: Will the guards here attack me?
faq.answer: Yes. The Scarlet Crusade sees outsiders, especially the Forsaken and their Horde allies, as corrupt enemies to purge in holy fire.

angles.text: As an undead traveler, you pass near a watchtower on the edge of Forsaken territory. Its living crusaders hold a pocket of ground in the glades.
As a member of the Horde, you must travel the eastern trails of Tirisfal with care. Scarlet sentries on the hill attack anyone heading toward the Monastery.
